candidate_classification.scientific_interpretation: Efficiency-calibrated 2% adaptive Mode-I solve (13,897 elements). Demonstrates near-identical elastic compliance (Delta K0 = -0.0405%, R2 = 0.99999960) and peak load (Delta F_max = -2.04%) vs S1 reference. Pre-peak work input matches S1 within -0.06% (Regime A). Post-peak softening is broadened with delayed load drop and non-zero residual force (F_res = 0.029 kN at u = 0.010 mm), yielding higher cumulative work (W_ext = 3.633 mJ) and fracture functional (E_frac = 3.193 mJ).

terminology_definitions.e_frac: Implemented phase-field crack-surface functional (SDV17), E_frac = integral Gamma_l(d) dOmega
terminology_definitions.delta_book: Descriptive energy bookkeeping diagnostic, Delta_book = E_model - W_ext (not a thermodynamic pass/fail criterion)

Regime_A_pre_peak.description: Linear elastic response and pre-peak micro-crack initiation

Regime_B_softening.description: Sharp macroscopic crack propagation through refined ligament

Regime_C_residual.description: Post-fracture residual state and separated ligament loading

causal_classification.pre_peak_agreement: VERIFIED (Delta K0 = -0.04%, Delta F_max = -2.04%, Regime A dW_ext diff = -0.001 mJ / -0.06%)
causal_classification.post_peak_energy_divergence_onset: VERIFIED (Onset occurs in Regime B at u ~ 0.0060 mm during crack breakthrough, intensifying in Regime C)
causal_classification.residual_elastic_energy_in_far_field: SUPPORTED_BUT_NOT_PROVEN (Adaptive E_elas in Regime C increases by +0.144 mJ due to residual far-field strain and residual tail force F_res = 0.029 kN)
causal_classification.full_spatial_damage_distribution_cause: UNRESOLVED (Requires full element-by-element contour audit of d and sigma across the coarse-fine transition zone)
